name: Stewvul, Ex-B.F.F.
summary: After Translating the Ledger, Narain Soothfancy says nothing can be translated without the scrying goggles. Narain's ex-best friend forever, Stewvul, stole them, and you are to find Stewvul and take them back.

sections.title: The Stolen Goggles
sections.body: Narain Soothfancy needs the scrying goggles before translating anything. They were stolen a while back by Stewvul, Narain's ex-best friend forever, who broke Narain's heart in five places and then abandoned Narain in this place.

sections.title: Where to Look
sections.body: With the help of a trusty crystal ball, Narain has narrowed Stewvul's whereabouts to two places. One is the Greymane Wall in Silverpine. The other is a world beyond a portal. You are the one to track Stewvul down and get the goggles back.

sections.title: What Stewvul Says
sections.body: Stewvul cannot believe Narain has found them. Stewvul will not go back, and is finished with being a friend only part of the time and a slave the rest.

faq.q: Why does Narain need the scrying goggles?
faq.answer: Narain says nothing can be translated without them.
Stewvul is Narain Soothfancy's ex-best friend forever. Stewvul stole the scrying goggles, broke Narain's heart in five places and then abandoned Narain here.

faq.q: Where does Narain think Stewvul is?
faq.answer: Narain's crystal ball narrows it to two places: the Greymane Wall in Silverpine, or a distant portal world.
Translating the Ledger, where you brought Azuregos's ledger to Narain.
